name: WooCommerce Sales & Inventory Reports via Email
author: Nakul Chandra

sections.description:
WooCommerce store owners don’t need to log in every day just to track performance.

WooCommerce Sales & Inventory Reports via Email sends automated email reports containing key sales and stock information directly to your inbox. You can choose how often reports are delivered — daily, weekly, or monthly — and stay informed without opening the WordPress dashboard.

The plugin uses WooCommerce’s native email system to ensure reliable delivery and consistent formatting. Reports are clean, readable, and optimized for desktop and mobile email clients.

Whether you manage a single store or oversee multiple products, this plugin helps you monitor revenue trends, best-selling products, and inventory status effortlessly.

Features

  • Automated sales summary emails
  • Inventory reports for low-stock and out-of-stock products
  • Flexible scheduling: daily, weekly, or monthly
  • Revenue and order count tracking
  • Top-selling product insights
  • Uses WooCommerce email templates
  • Runs automatically via WP-Cron
  • No manual exports or spreadsheets required

Configuration

After activation:

  1. Navigate to WooCommerce → Settings → Email Reports.
  2. Choose the report frequency (Daily, Weekly, or Monthly).
  3. Enter the email address for receiving reports.
  4. Select the report type:
    • Sales Summary
    • Inventory Report
    • Both
  5. Save your settings.

Reports will be sent automatically based on your selected schedule.

Email Report Contents

Each report may include:

  • Total revenue for the selected period
  • Number of completed orders
  • Best-selling products
  • Low-stock items
  • Out-of-stock products

All data is displayed in a clear HTML table format using WooCommerce email styling.

Customization

Email templates can be customized by copying them from:

/templates/emails/

into your theme’s WooCommerce email override directory.

This allows full control over layout, text, and branding.

Compatibility

  • Requires WooCommerce 5.0 or higher
  • Compatible with the latest WordPress versions
  • Works with most SMTP and email delivery plugins
  • Tested on standard shared and managed hosting environments
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to WordPress Admin → Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the ZIP file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and activated.

Can I change the email design?

Yes. Email templates can be overridden in your theme.

How are emails sent?

Emails are sent automatically using WP-Cron and WooCommerce’s email system.

Can I stop or change report frequency?

Yes. You can update or disable reports anytime from WooCommerce → Settings → Email Reports.
